missing.fr: Empty: French pages show the English text.
missing.en: Empty: English pages show the French text.

publish.never: Not published yet: visitors see the growing note
publish.pending: Your changes are in the draft and not visible to visitors yet.
publish.upToDate: Visitors see the same content as the draft.
publish.confirmFull: Visitors will see the full page exactly as it is in the draft preview now.
publish.confirmNote: Visitors will see the “still growing” note instead of the full page, with the texts of the draft.
publish.fullDone: Published: visitors see the full page.
publish.noteDone: Published: visitors see the growing note.
publish.scope: Texts, links, images and legal pages wait for “Publish”; products, conventions and shipping are live at once.

texts.title: Texts
texts.subtitle: Everything written on the site, section by section.
texts.linksHint: Write [Etsy](https://www.etsy.com/…) to turn a word into a link.
texts.paragraphsHint: Leave an empty line between two paragraphs.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: Shown next to the studio name at the top of the site. A PNG with a transparent background works best; it is resized to 800 pixels.
logo.removeMessage: The site will show the studio name only.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.hint: Type the name of any font from Google Fonts. The site downloads it and serves it itself: visitors never contact Google.
fonts.heading: Titles

identity.title: Name and introduction
identity.searchTitleHint: About 60 characters, e.g. “mossyleaf.studio – hand-drawn critter illustrations”. Empty: the studio name.
identity.metaDescription: Description for search engines and link previews

shopNotes.title: Shop notes
shopNotes.announcementHint: One line at the very top of every shop page, e.g. “Free shipping from 40 €”. Empty: no bar.
shopNotes.priceNoteHint: E.g. “VAT not applicable, art. 293 B of the French tax code”. Empty: no line.

links.title: Links
links.subtitle: The cards shown under the introduction. Drag them to change the order.
links.emptyHint: Add the shop and Instagram so visitors can find them.

images.title: Images
images.subtitle: The featured drawing sits under the introduction, the others in the gallery. Drag them to change the order.
images.formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 20 MB. Large images are resized to 1600 pixels.
images.alt: Description for people who can’t see the image
images.altHint: What the drawing shows, in a short sentence.
images.deleteMessage: The image will disappear from the site.
images.emptyHint: Add a few drawings: the first one you feature appears at the top of the site.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Pushed by mossytrunk. Add photos, titles and descriptions here, and choose what the shop shows. Drag rows to change the order.
products.filtering: Reordering is off while a search or filter is active.
products.emptyHint: Products appear here once mossytrunk pushes its catalogue.
products.noMatchHint: Try another word or another category.
products.retiredHint: mossytrunk retired this product: it cannot be shown in the shop.
products.loadFailed: The products could not be loaded

product.notFoundHint: It may have been removed from the catalogue.

mossytrunk.title: From mossytrunk
mossytrunk.hint: These come from mossytrunk and cannot be changed here.
mossytrunk.name: Name

photos.title: Photos
photos.hint: The first photo is the cover. Shop lists crop it square, so keep the subject centred.
photos.formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 20 MB. Large photos are resized to 1600 pixels.
photos.deleteMessage: The photo will disappear from the product page.
photos.emptyHint: Add at least one photo: products without a photo look empty in the shop.

texts.title: Shop texts
texts.name: Title
texts.nameHint: Empty: the shop shows the name from mossytrunk, “{name}”.
texts.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. fox-print. It ends the address of the product page.

product.loadFailed: The product could not be loaded
product.leave: Leave without saving? Your changes to the shop texts will be lost.

categories.title: Category names
categories.hint: How each mossytrunk category is called in the shop.
categories.emptyDetail: Categories appear once mossytrunk pushes its catalogue.

conventions.title: Conventions
conventions.subtitle: Where the studio will be. Changes show in the shop at once, no need to publish.
conventions.deleteMessage: “{name}” will disappear from the shop at once.
conventions.emptyHint: Add the next one so visitors know where to find the studio.

legal.title: Legal pages
legal.subtitle: Terms, notices and policies shown in the shop footer. Waits for “Publish” like the texts.
legal.hidden: Empty: not shown in the shop
legal.hint: Blocks: start a line with “## ” for a heading, with “- ” for a list item, leave a blank line between paragraphs, and write [label](https://…) for a link.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.subtitle: Where the studio ships, and what it costs.
shipping.hint: A zone left off cannot be chosen at checkout. Saving a zone puts it live at once, no need to publish.

covers.eu: The other 26 member states of the European Union.

shipping.freeFromHint: Leave empty to never offer free shipping.
shipping.invalidAmount: Enter an amount in euros up to 10,000, like 4.50.
